market_question: Will Thomas Massie be the Republican nominee for KY-04?
reasoning: Thomas Massie is the long-serving incumbent with a strong libertarian and Tea Party base in a deep-red district. After surviving a close 2020 primary, he has dominated subsequent primaries (75% in 2024). No credible primary challenger has emerged for 2026, and past Trump-backed opposition failed to unseat him. Absent an unprecedented retirement or scandal, his nomination probability is overwhelmingly high, likely around 90%, while the market implies a coin flip.
evidence_points: Massie has held the seat since 2012 and won his 2024 primary with 75%.
He improved from a narrow 50.6% in 2020 to unimpeded victories in 2022 and 2024.
KY-04 is a safe Republican district, making the primary the only real contest, and no notable opponent has declared.
Historical incumbency renomination rates exceed 95% in the House, and any challenge would need extraordinary factors not currently visible.
